title: Meeting rehearsal
summary: Open your meeting, take the hardest questions from the toughest person first, and ask for a decision.

phases.title: Your opening
phases.goal: The opening line has been spoken and the floor is the user's. The user opens: what they want and why. At most one interruption from an impatient attendee, only on the long answer marker.

phases.title: Questions
phases.goal: Three or four hard questions, the most skeptical attendee first, each from an open concern related to what the user just said.

phases.title: Decision
phases.goal: The chair asks what exactly they are asking for. The decision maker states the outcome from the meeting state, with conditions or what is missing. When the user runs the meeting, wait for the user to ask; then the decision maker answers in their own words.

phases.title: Close
phases.goal: The chair reads back next steps with owners and dates in one or two sentences and calls end_round. When the user runs the meeting, it ends on the user's close; the decision maker says one short line and calls end_round.
